qualified_opportunity_v1.acceptanceRule: COMM-CONV-001 must explicitly return conversion_acceptance_v1 or conversion_rejection_v1. Rejection returns ownership to Run 012 with typed remediation reasons and grants no authority.

rules: Run 012 ends operational ownership at qualified_opportunity_v1 only after COMM-CONV-001 explicitly accepts it.
A rejected conversion handoff returns ownership to Run 012 for remediation or nurture.
Final commercial scope, payment, fulfillment, delivery and customer-success actions are downstream and out of scope for Run 012.
External first-touch execution requires a separate exact approval permit for the actionId.
Claims used in public content must retain evidence references.
Customer or prospect sensitive data must be minimized before cross-agent handoff.
Duplicate source opportunities must share an idempotency key and be suppressed before review.
Revenue attribution must distinguish booked and collected revenue; recurring revenue must be explicitly identified when available.
Case-study/proof inputs are feedback only and require verified evidence plus applicable publication permission.
